# Reviewed behavior declarations

This supplementary catalogue covers explicitly reviewed behaviors that need no separate setting or action. It is not an exhaustive product inventory or a native application delivery certificate. A declared behavior may have a documented limitation. Application Undo and automatic Backspace restoration are distinct.

Edit `_shared/modules/features/behaviors.json` after reviewing the named owners, then run `npm run codegen:feature-inventory`. Any changed owner file blocks generation until its source receipt is explicitly reviewed; generation never updates review hashes. These conservative whole-file hashes detect source drift, not semantic correctness or an unlisted capability.

| Behavior                            | Windows                                                                                              | macOS                                                                                                                                                 | Linux                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ★ key repeats last keystroke        | Declared: Repeats a mid-word character when no expansion matches and magic-key repeat is enabled.    | Declared: Repeats a mid-word character when no expansion matches and magic-key repeat is enabled.                                                     | Declared: Magic-key repeat exists, but consecutive repeats currently lose their context after the first expansion. Following repeat-correction mappings are also affected. |
| Restore an expansion with Backspace | Not declared: No automatic trigger restoration with Backspace; the application’s Undo is separate.   | Not declared: No automatic trigger restoration with Backspace; the application’s Undo is separate.                                                    | Declared: An immediate unmodified Backspace can restore an eligible plain-text expansion; native text-field behavior remains unqualified.                                  |
| Magic-key repeat activation window  | Not declared: No separate activation window for fallback repetition; idle word reset is independent. | Declared: Uses the effective magic-key activation window, including modifier timing rules; zero disables this window. Idle word reset is independent. | Not declared: No separate activation window for fallback repetition; idle word reset is independent.                                                                       |
